subject: community-medicine
title: Ayushman Bharat: Health and Wellness Centres and PM-JAY Assurance

steps.title: Two arms, one announcement
steps.tx: **Ayushman Bharat** (2018) joined comprehensive primary care through 1.5 lakh health and wellness centres (now Ayushman Arogya Mandirs) with hospitalisation assurance through Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana for the deprived bottom roughly 40 percent of families. Prevention near home plus protection from hospital bills is the whole doctrine in one sentence.
steps.say: Two arms, one doctrine. Wellness centres near home for comprehensive primary care; assurance against hospital bills for the poorest two fifths of families. Prevention plus protection, announced together in 2018.

steps.title: PM-JAY entitlement: 5 lakh per family per year
steps.tx: **PM-JAY cover** is 5 lakh rupees per entitled family per year on a floater basis for hospitalisation, cashless at empanelled hospitals, portable across states. Entitlement derives from SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria, not income certificates or premiums: no enrolment fee, no cap on family size or age, pre-existing diseases covered from day one in the standard teaching list.
steps.say: Five lakh per family yearly, floating across members, portable across states, cashless at empanelled doors. Deprivation lists entitle; no premiums, no size caps, pre-existing disease covered from day one.

rows: 5 lakh per family per year, floater
Cashless across states at empanelled hospitals

steps.title: Packages, rates and the purchasing logic
steps.tx: **Health benefit packages** (about 1900+ procedures across specialities in current counts) carry fixed rates hospitals accept for empanelment, revised periodically with cost evidence. Strategic purchasing means the state buys defined care at defined prices with quality conditions, replacing open-ended reimbursement. Fraud analytics (ghost admissions, upcoding) police the model from claims data.
steps.say: Fixed packages, fixed prices, quality conditions: strategic purchasing replaces open bills. Nineteen hundred procedures rated, claims mined for ghosts and upcoding. The purchaser disciplines the market deliberately.

nodes.label: Claim audited and paid at package rate

steps.title: Wellness centres: the CHO-led team
steps.tx: Each **Ayushman Arogya Mandir** is led by a community health officer (nursing or AYUSH graduate with bridge training) over multipurpose workers and ASHAs, delivering the 12 comprehensive packages with free essential drugs and expanding diagnostics, plus teleconsultation (eSanjeevani) upward to PHC medical officers and specialists. Population enumeration and family folders anchor its register.
steps.say: A mid-level leader runs the centre. Community health officer over multipurpose workers and ASHAs, twelve packages, free drugs, teleconsultation upward. Enumerated family folders anchor every register she keeps.

steps.title: Continuum the two arms promise
steps.tx: The **continuum promise** runs screening at wellness centres, treatment of uncomplicated disease locally, referral into PM-JAY hospitals for entitled families (and public referral care for all), then back-referral for follow-up and medicines near home. Breaks in the return leg (no records home, medicines unavailable locally) are where evaluations find the design leaking.
steps.say: Screen locally, treat locally, refer upward, return home for follow-up. Evaluations find leaks on the return leg: records missing, medicines stocked out. The loop, not the launch, is the intervention.

steps.title: Digital spine: ABHA and registries
steps.tx: The **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission** issues ABHA health accounts linking records across facilities with consent-managed sharing, registries of facilities and professionals, and teleconsultation rails. Examiners frame it as infrastructure, not care itself: identifiers and interoperability that both arms increasingly ride on, with privacy law as its stated guardrail.
steps.say: Identifiers underpin both arms. Health accounts link records with consent, facility and professional registries standardise the map, teleconsultation rides the rails. Infrastructure, not care; privacy law is the guardrail.

steps.title: Out-of-pocket expenditure: the target metric
steps.tx: **Out-of-pocket expenditure** (roughly half of India's health spending in recent national accounts, falling slowly) is the doctrine's enemy metric, driven by outpatient drugs and diagnostics more than hospitalisation nationally. Critics therefore judge Ayushman Bharat by whether the free primary arm, not only insurance, expands; insurance alone cannot touch the commonest spending.
steps.say: Household spending is the enemy metric. Hospital bills are only part; outpatient drugs and tests dominate nationally. The free primary arm, not insurance alone, must move that number.

steps.title: State models vary under one banner
steps.tx: **Implementation varies**: some states run PM-JAY in insurance mode with companies, others in trust mode through state health agencies paying directly, and several merged state schemes into the national entitlement (with a few large states joining late or running parallel schemes historically). Federal variation under common entitlement rules is the accurate one-line summary for essays.
steps.say: One banner, several engines. Insurance companies in some states, public trusts in others, merged state schemes beneath national entitlement. Federal variation under common rules is the accurate summary.

steps.title: Ayushman versus the older RSBY
steps.tx: **Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana** (2008) insured BPL families for 30000 rupees yearly through insurers, the direct ancestor whose lessons (enrolment friction, hospitalisation-only cover, low awareness) PM-JAY scaled past with 5 lakh assurance, entitlement lists and a simultaneous primary care arm. Exam narratives present PM-JAY as RSBY's correction, not its synonym.
steps.say: Ancestry matters. Thirty thousand through insurers in 2008 taught enrolment friction and hospital-only limits. Five lakh entitlement assurance plus a primary arm is the correction, never the synonym.
